designationHistory.indexText: Established May 31, 2003, on former Fort McClellan Army land transferred to the Fish and Wildlife Service under the Bob Stump National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2003.

authority.citation: Bob Stump National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2003, P.L. 107-314

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Mountain Longleaf National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
FWS ServCat: I&M plan, Mountain Longleaf NWR (cites USFWS 2003 "Proposed Establishment of Mountain Longleaf NWR" and the Bob Stump NDAA for FY2003)

review.note: Confirmed as legislatively based (Bob Stump NDAA FY2003, signed by George W. Bush Dec. 2, 2002); May 31, 2003 is the transfer/establishment date from the FWS page. The act's section number was not checked.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: The 7,759 acre refuge was legislatively established on May 31, 2003 within the former military training base of Fort McClellan.
